codes.note: No legend in the bundle. SR is read as SOFR, the Blue Owl convention, but the filer does not define it here.
Appears only in 2023 filings, before the move to SOFR.

note: Each cell holds a reference-rate code plus a spread and nothing else (no floor or other terms), and the tagged spread equals the printed number on every compared row. The cell is therefore a rate-terms cell that happens to carry only the spread number.
